question.:question/problem:
Evaluate the following integral. Do not round the answer.

$\frac{2}{3}\int_{5}^{125}\frac{8}{3\left(\frac{x}{1}\right){log}_{5}({\left(\frac{x}{1}\right)}^{2})}\,\text{d}x=($
{{field-1}}
$)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡5$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=\log_{5}\left(\left(\frac{x}{1}\right)^{2}\right).$ Differentiating, we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2}{x \ln{\left(5 \right)}}\,⟹\,\frac{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}{2}\,\text{d}u=\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Calculating the limits for $u$ gives the following:

| $x$ | $5$ | $125$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $u$ | $2$ | $6$ |

We now substitute and evaluate as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3}\int_{5}^{125}\frac{8}{3\left(\frac{x}{1}\right){log}_{5}({\left(\frac{x}{1}\right)}^{2})}\,\text{d}x \\ & =\frac{16}{9}\int_{5}^{125}\frac{1}{{log}_{5}({\left(\frac{x}{1}\right)}^{2})}\cdot \frac{1}{\left(\frac{x}{1}\right)}\,\text{d}x \\ & =\frac{16}{9}\int_{2}^{6}\frac{1}{u}\cdot \frac{\operatorname{ln}5}{2}\,\text{d}u \\ & =\frac{8 \ln{\left(5 \right)}}{9}\int_{2}^{6}\frac{1}{u}\,\text{d}u \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\cdot\left(\frac{4\operatorname{ln}5}{3}(\operatorname{ln}Abs(u))\right)|_{2}^{6} \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\cdot\left(\frac{4\operatorname{ln}5}{3}(\operatorname{ln}6-\operatorname{ln}2)\right) \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\cdot\left(\frac{4\operatorname{ln}5}{3}\operatorname{ln}3\right) \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\cdot\left((\frac{4}{3}\operatorname{ln}3)\operatorname{ln}5\right)\end{aligned}
$$
